claims.claim: The Go types backing RuntimeConfig schema live in `pkg/config/runtime_config.go` and `pkg/config/types.go`
apiVersion must be `promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1`
kind must be `RuntimeConfig`
Provider role `llm` is the default
Provider role values: llm, image, video, tts, stt, embedding, inference, rerank
Provider id defaults to type value
LLM provider types registered by SDK import: claude, openai, gemini, ollama; mock needs a blank import
Image provider types: imagen
Embedding provider types: openai, gemini, ollama, voyageai, bedrock, vertex, huggingface
Rerank provider types: voyageai, cohere, mock
Inference provider types: huggingface, openai, systemone, nvidia-topic-control (alias: openai + NemoGuard topic control)
vllm provider is registered by `runtime/providers/vllm`
replay provider is registered by `runtime/providers/replay`
vllm provider import path: `github.com/AltairaLabs/PromptKit/runtime/v2/providers/vllm`
Credentials are resolved in order of precedence: api_key > credential_file > credential_env
stream_retry retry_window default is pre_first_chunk
stream_retry retry_window values: pre_first_chunk (default) or always
stream_retry max_attempts default: 2
stream_retry initial_delay default: `250ms` (Go duration string)
stream_retry max_delay default: 2s (Go duration string)
StreamRetryPolicy.MaxRetryAfter can be changed in code to adjust 60-second cap
stream_idle_timeout default: `30s` (Go duration string)
stream_max_concurrent default: 0 (unlimited)
http_transport max_conns_per_host default: 100
http_transport max_idle_conns_per_host default: 100
http_transport idle_conn_timeout default: `90s` (Go duration string)
Tool spec modes: `mock` (canned responses), `live` (HTTP), `exec` (subprocess), or `client` (client-side execution)
Tool spec requires description field
Tool spec requires input_schema (JSON Schema Draft-07)
Tool spec requires output_schema (JSON Schema Draft-07)
Tool spec requires mode field
Exec tool runtime default: `exec` (one-shot), or `server` (long-running JSON-RPC)
Hook interface types: `provider`, `tool`, or `session`

Hook mode values: filter (synchronous, can modify/deny; default) or observe (the runtime waits for the process, bounded by timeout_ms or 10 seconds when unset, then discards its output and any failure)
Provider hook valid phases: before_call, after_call
Tool hook valid phases: before_execution, after_execution
Session hook valid phases: `session_start`, `session_update`, `session_end`
MCP server config requires name field
MCP server needs exactly one transport: command (stdio) or url; command is conditional
tool_filter allowlist is applied first, then blocklist removes from the result
state_store type values: `memory` (default), `redis`, or `file`
Redis database field accepts int 0-15 (default: 0)
Redis ttl default: `24h` (Go duration string)
Redis prefix default: `promptkit`
File state_store fsync values: `off`, `on-save` (default), `on-append`
File state_store ttl_days default: 0 (disabled)
Logging defaultLevel values: `trace`, `debug`, `info` (default), `warn`, `error`
Logging format values: `text` (default) or `json`
More specific module names take precedence over less specific ones in logging
Example RuntimeConfig uses apiVersion `promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1` and kind `RuntimeConfig`
Example shows Claude model claude-sonnet-4-20250514
Example shows embedding provider type `voyageai` with model `voyage-3`
Example tool mode `exec` with runtime `server`
Example tool mode `live` with HTTP method GET
Example hook type provider with phases before_call, after_call
Example hook type tool with phase after_execution
Example MCP server uses npx command with @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem args
Example MCP server tool_filter blocklist includes `delete_file`
Example state_store type `redis` with database `1`
Example logging defaultLevel `info` with format `json`
platform.type values: `bedrock`, `vertex`, or `azure`
type field is required on every provider entry
model field required for completion roles (llm, image, video)
Provider capabilities values: `text`, `streaming`, `vision`, `tools`, `json`, `audio`, `video`, `documents`
request_timeout is a Go duration string (e.g., 60s, 2m), does not apply to streaming
Provider headers are sent on every request; a header the provider sets itself fails the request with an error naming it
request_timeout on capability roles keeps the provider's own default when unset

Roles llm, image and video honor all tuning fields; tts, stt, embedding, inference and rerank honor headers, request_timeout and http_transport and reject stream_idle_timeout, stream_retry, stream_max_concurrent and defaults.prompt_caching with an error naming field and role
On a capability role, http_transport replaces the provider's transport with a pooled, instrumented one
A provider type that cannot take tuning for its role (mock reranker) fails to load when any is set
openai and nvidia-topic-control inference types reject request_timeout alongside additional_config.timeout_seconds
rate_limit has optional rps and burst; rps 0 is unlimited, a burst below 1 counts as 1 and is ignored when rps is 0

rate_limit takes a token per HTTP request: completion calls, capability calls and every retry attempt; requests through one provider share a bucket and providers built from one entry each get their own
A waiting request gives up when its context is canceled; a request whose turn falls past its deadline fails at once, is not sent and is not retried; waiting does not count against request_timeout
The credential is applied once per attempt after the wait; a redirect to the same scheme and host is authorized again, a redirect to another host is sent without the credential
The rate limit counts HTTP requests only; a WebSocket realtime or duplex session is not limited
Pricing fields are optional; the provider prices from its built-in table unless both rates are positive
Every defaults field is optional; an omitted field or a zero is unset and the request's own value or the provider's default applies
A one-shot exec tool that lists env names receives only those variables, none listed inherits the host environment, a server tool receives the host environment plus the listed names
